name: pkstack
description: pstack's body, kstack's nervous system. A standalone fork merging Lauren Tan's pstack (vendored subtree, MIT) with kstack's build discipline: the poteto-mode router and playbooks carrying kstack's finding ledger, Bennett's-razor lessons, the instantiated-lessons map, and the close-unit self-improvement loop — wired natively at the playbooks' own chokepoints, ledger-blind wherever sampling happens.
